about_the_game:
Warning: This game contains flashes of light that may affect individuals with photosensitive epilepsy. Please play with caution.

You awaken in a dark, cold basement, an odd echo resonating in the distance. You don’t know where you are or how you got here, but you sense this place is alive. It’s not just the house; the entire surroundings seem to pulse with an unsettling energy. CoRoT is a first-person psychological horror experience that immerses you in a space where the rules of reality fade away. The story isn’t delivered outright, it unveils itself through abandoned cassettes and details whispered by the place itself.

You explore hallways that shift direction, rooms that transform when you look away, and listen to recordings that unravel a disturbing past. As you seek to understand where you are and what’s happening, a former resident of this house stalks you from the shadows. But there’s something else, something watching with an intent you can’t quite grasp.

CoRoT marks the beginning of a cosmic horror universe, built with a deep lore we plan to expand. This is the first step into a broader world, where secrets stretch beyond what you can see.

Beware of ´that´

Pay attention to ´that´. It knows who you are. Stay vigilant.

What Awaits You

You’ll explore a living environment, with realistic graphics that capture every detail and heighten the oppressive atmosphere. The voices on the cassettes, recorded by real actors, not computer-generated, bring a fragmented narrative to life, demanding your careful attention. The space reacts to your actions, shifting as if it holds its own memory. A former resident relentlessly pursues you, while a 3D sound design envelops you, making every noise question your surroundings.

Why You Should Play

CoRoT isn’t about fleeting scares. It’s crafted for those who seek a bond with the unknown, for those who value diving into a mystery without clear answers. If the tension of P.T. or the silent atmosphere of ANATOMY ever captivated you, this game will draw you in. Put on your headphones, turn off the lights, and step into this nightmare. Prepare for what you might find, or... what might find you.

Additional Notes

The experience lasts 1 to 2 hours, depending on how long you spend exploring and listening. For the full effect, play in the dark with headphones; sound is essential.

content_descriptors.notes: CoRoT features descriptions of murders and subtle hints of torture conveyed through audio and text. Additionally, players may encounter corpses or fragments of them, along with blood.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-7400 or AMD Ryzen 5 1400
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 970 or AMD Radeon RX 580
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 12 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-9600K or AMD Ryzen 5 3600
  • Memory: 12 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 2070 or AMD Radeon RX 5700 XT
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 12 GB available space

short_description: CoRoT is a first-person psychological horror game. Search for cassettes in a transforming house, unraveling its macabre past. A sinister atmosphere surrounds you as you try to understand what's happening and where you really are. Can you discover the truth hidden in its walls?
supported_languages:
English*, Spanish - Spain, Simplified Chinese, Korean, Spanish - Latin America, Japanese, Russian
*languages with full audio support
